externalWiring.web/vite.config.ts: verify-english-catalog-split buildStart plugin — runs on every `vite build` and `vite dev`, i.e. on every CI job that builds the SPA.

audits.asserts: Every EmptyState carries an actionable CTA.
Recharts tooltip content uses readable token colours.
No i18n key is shadowed by a namespace of the same name.
Query hooks thread an AbortSignal.
Every DataTable declares a stable tableId for persisted prefs.
Filter bars surface active-filter chips.
Windows High Contrast / forced-colors survivability.
sr-only text uses the shared VisuallyHidden primitive.
Interactive controls have a computable accessible name.
Page structure exposes the required ARIA landmarks.
Animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Charts expose an accessible description/table alternative.
Charts are wrapped in the shared ChartContainer frame.
Chart data access is null-safe.
Multi-series charts ship a toggleable legend.
Maps with many markers use clustering.
Expensive filters are deferred off the keystroke path.
Route links prefetch their lazy chunk.
Tag inputs use the shared primitive.
Required form fields are marked programmatically.
Unit-bearing inputs convert at the display boundary.
Sensitive values render through the masking primitive.
Layout uses logical (RTL-safe) properties.
Polling pauses when the tab is hidden.
Data surfaces expose an export affordance.
Live mutations invalidate the right query keys.
Complex surfaces carry inline help.
Interactive targets meet the minimum touch size.
Gauges size from tokens, not magic pixel widths.
Text uses the typography role components/tokens.
Every dark-mode surface has a light-mode counterpart.
Hot tables are virtualized, AND the set of unvirtualized long-list surfaces derived by a source scan matches the acknowledged set exactly (in both directions).
audits.clean08: Was defined in package.json but unreachable from any CI command, and its PENDING_MIGRATION list printed a WARN nobody could fail on. The follow-up AUDIT_VIRTUALIZATION_BACKLOG_LIMIT ceiling was vacuous — a hardcoded six-item array compared against a default of six, so it could only fire if somebody edited the array. Replaced with `discoverLongListSurfaces()`, which recomputes the set from the sources on every run and fails on a NEW unvirtualized long-list surface anywhere in the app as well as on a stale acknowledgement.

audits.asserts: No page uses a bare <Spinner/> as its whole loading state.

audits.clean08: Was defined in package.json but unreachable from any CI command, and failing: components/charts/LinearGauge.tsx used duration-500, which does NOT collapse under prefers-reduced-motion. Fixed to duration-slow and wired into `npm run lint`.

audits.asserts: Adjacent chart palette entries stay distinguishable (lightness + hue deltas) and the source constants have not drifted.

archived.reason: Premise inverted. It counted direct `lucide-react` imports as debt to be migrated into a central non-tree-shakeable icon registry — the same shape as force-grouping lucide-react in manualChunks, which hoisted 421 icon modules into the shell and was removed to bring startup JS under budget. Per-route direct imports are now the required pattern.
